name: Polinyà (Spain)
description: The first vertical half white, followed by a yellow pale and a light blue fly bearing a yellow horizontal stripe at the centre.
history: The flag was approved on 22 November 2012 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 6270 of 10 December 2012; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, white in the first vertical half, then a yellow pale 1/9 of the length and the rest light blue, with a yellow fess 1/6 of the height at the centre of that part.

features.role: fess 1/6 of the height on the light blue fly
